full_details: At the morning rehearsal you had Egeon's roll and did not yet know the tooth. At the Jackdaw, mutton and the heel of a loaf, the left side below answered the bread like a struck bell, and you put the bread down. Pope asked where it pained, and for once you pointed at the place you meant. Burbage offered a royal progress to the barber. Agnes, who has buried two husbands, offered a clove held on it, or a hot knitting-needle. You chose the clove. A pennyworth on the way home and another for the night, written later as Item, cloves, ij d. At two you were Egeon, and you told the shipwreck out of the right side of your mouth. At supper Mistress Ansell looked by candle. The nether great tooth, on the left, is black at the neck. She said you will lose it. You said it will settle. She said it will settle when it is in a dish. You wrote till ten on nothing but stubbornness. The back was not thought of once. You did not open the coffer.
one_sentence: A crust at the Jackdaw started the left tooth, you chose a clove, and played Egeon out of the right side of your mouth.
title: Chose the clove and played Egeon
